QuestInfo.name: Hunter's Luck - Week 1
QuestInfo.0:
The time between February and March is what many call the prime hunting season! Receive some hunting pointers from Scadur and become the best hunter on the block!#b

<Event Period>
February 19, 2010 - February 21, 2010

<How to Join the Event>
1. Receive the 2x EXP item that Scadur hands out once a week.
2. Use the item when in need of an extra boost of Luck.
3. Hunt away!

<Notes>
1. 2x EXP item will expire at midnight on Sunday.
2. New 2x item will become available the following Monday.

0.0: The new hunting season has begun! I have been waiting year-round for it to get this cold! Hmm? You don't know? Feb. 19th through Mar. 28th is the best time for hunting! If you miss that season, you're not a serious hunter. It's that important. You know, I can give you a special tip on how to hunt effectively. Are you interested?

no.0: Hey, people line up for miles to hear my secret for successful hunting. I sincerely hope you don't regret your decision, but you will.

1.0: It's called #bHunter's Luck#k. Use it when you need some luck. The EXP you earn through hunting will temporarily double when you do! The Hunter's Luck will disappear each Sunday, so I suggest you use it before then. Don't worry, you'll get a new one the Monday after.
